Data:Slnev.agdistis.morgen.json.startdescription: Agdistis and Morgen share news of his friend, and her un-sister, the Ligeian Sulochana (who, it seems, was at one point Morgen's dance-instructor). She is in Georgia now: Agdistis wonders why. 'Medea,' Morgen says, but she teasingly refuses to be drawn on what that might mean. [Lesson: Serpents & Venoms]

Data:Slnev.agdistis.olympe.json.startdescription: Agdistis and Olympe speak of the kind of wounds that words as weapons may cause - the big ones and the little ones. They speak also of the creation of stars - the big ones, and the little ones… [Lesson: Pyroglyphics]

Data:Slnev.agdistis.serena.json.startdescription: Agdistis and Serena discuss a masked play - a sort of degenerate Sufic hybrid - that he saw in Alexandria some years ago. 'They would only perform it,' he says, 'in the hours before dawn.' Serena nods: 'I think that was wise.' [Lesson: Watchman's Paradoxes]

Data:Slnev.agdistis.stanislav.json.startdescription: Agdistis and Stanislav talk about gardening under glass in winter. Their tone is fatherly. [Lesson: Leaves & Thorns]

Data:Slnev.agdistis.visiting.denzil.json.startdescription: Agdistis enumerates a number of 'smithing songs', tapping on the table as he does so. Denzil nods politely, but is clearly paying no attention. [Lesson: Drums & Dances]

Data:Slnev.agdistis.visiting.killes.json.startdescription: Mrs Kille and Agdistis revisit the memories of their time of acquaintance in Paris. He asks if she is still in touch with 'Aunt Adeline', and she emphatically shakes her head. 'When I married Mr Kille,' she says firmly, 'I told him I'd put all that behind me. He's a good man.' [Lesson: Rhyme & Remembrance]

Data:Slnev.agdistis.visiting.timothy.jso.startdescription: Timothy and Agdistis are discussing historical accounts of the mountain rites of the Phrygians. Both of them noticeably lower their voices whenever they mention the word 'Grail'. [Lesson: Tridesma Hiera]

Data:Slnev.agdistis.yvette.json.startdescription: Agdistis listens as Yvette expounds her theories on the paintings of Nina Lagasse: how, Yvette believes, her choice of colours over the years shows that she knew when her time was coming to an end. [Lesson: Sights & Sensations]

Data:Slnev.agdistis.zachary.json.startdescription: Zachary speaks with staccato enthusiasm of the poetic sabotage efforts of someone he calls 'Hammerbreaker'. His voice remains flat but his hands twitch wildly: his fingers beat a complex rhythm on the tabletop. Agdistis listens sympathetically. [Lesson: Putrefactions & Calcinations]

Data:Slnev.aladim.agdistis.json.startdescription: Al-Adim and Agdistis are gossiping, quietly, about al-Adim's patroness. 'Not a hundred legs,' says al-Adim, 'but more than you'd think…' [Lesson: Sky Stories]

Data:Slnev.aladim.arthur.json.startdescription: Al-Adim asks Arthur if he ever thought to grow Long, but Arthur shakes his head. 'Too many sacrifices - too many more. I know your patroness is gentler. But I will not pay the price, nor have others pay it for me.' [Lesson: Auroral Contemplations]

Data:Slnev.aladim.arun.json.startdescription: Al-Adim is chaffing Arun about the fading potency of 'your venoms'. Arun is clearly subsiding into a sulk. [Lesson: Serpents & Venoms]

Data:Slnev.aladim.azita.json.startdescription: Azita and al-Adim discuss the varieties of messenger-birds and courier-spirits that they have employed across the centuries of their acquaintance. [Lesson: Sky Stories]

Data:Slnev.aladim.chaima.json.startdescription: Chaima listens intently while al-Adim describes the rare occasions on which labhites have been successfully brought to ground. Neither of them look happy. [Lesson: Horns & Ivories]

Data:Slnev.aladim.connie.json.startdescription: Connie and al-Adim are discussing the stories about Franklin Bancroft and Eva Dewulf - heads together - smiling. Evidently the location has inspired them. [Lesson: Pearl & Tide]

Data:Slnev.aladim.coquille.json.startdescription: Al-Adim politely interrogates Coquille about her family and nature. Yes, she is associated with the Tomb of Lies; no, she is no longer welcome there; yes, she is, she supposes, technically a pentiment… [Lesson: Pentiments & Precursors]

Data:Slnev.aladim.corso.json.startdescription: Al-Adim is reminiscing to Corso about Yarden of Nishapur, who knew the 'songs that came before the sun'… [Lesson: Pentiments & Precursors]

Data:Slnev.aladim.dagmar.json.startdescription: Al-Adim and Dagmar are engrossed in a deeply technical discussion about the accuracy - and possible transience - of Westergren's accounts of the Mansus. (Dagmar keeps deferentially reminding al-Adim that she's never passed the Stag Door.) [Lesson: Path & Pilgrim]

Data:Slnev.aladim.douglas.json.startdescription: Al-Adim is spinning tales of his travels, in the mountains of Persia, the taiga of the farthest East, the snows of Antarctica… Douglas listens, enraptured. 'Sometimes,' he says gruffly, 'I wish I'd done things different.' [Lesson: Path & Pilgrim]

Data:Slnev.aladim.ehsan.json.startdescription: Ehsan and al-Adim discuss the care and feeding of birds of prey. [Lesson: Furs & Feathers]

Data:Slnev.aladim.fraser.json.startdescription: Al-Adim, the historian, and Fraser, the collector, debate the longevity and the peril of their favourite Great Inks. [Lesson: Inks of Power]

Data:Slnev.aladim.hokobald.json.startdescription: Hokobald expounds on his belief that the Great Ink called Orpiment Exultant is - or will become - a Name of the Chandler. Al-Adim listens first with incredulity, but then with sceptical interest. [Lesson: Inks of Power]

Data:Slnev.aladim.morgen.json.startdescription: Al-Adim and Morgen discuss the meditations of Abbot Thomas of St Brandan's. Morgen asks if al-Adim ever met the Abbot. 'I acknowledge that I am rather older than you,' he replies, a little stiffly, 'but I am not that old.' [Lesson: Applebright Euphonies]

Data:Slnev.aladim.olympe.json.startdescription: Al-Adim and Olympe exchange stories of meetings with the prehuman dead: gentle things that yearn for a redder sun, and hungrier things that seek human blood to satisfy that yearning. [Lesson: Stone Stories]

Data:Slnev.aladim.serena.json.startdescription: Al-Adim and Serena discuss the Great Inks of Power and their personalities. Serena is concerned that the use of a particular ink might alter the meaning of a text. Al-Adim considers this a benefit; or a way to add meaning to the text; or at least something fundamental. [Lesson: Inks of Power]

Data:Slnev.aladim.stanislav.json.startdescription: Al-Adim describes his memories of Thirza Blake, and her work, in his time as Secretary Nunciant of the House. He is clearly caught between affection and annoyance. Stanislav shakes his head: 'I wish I had known her. I think we'd have got on.' [Lesson: Herbs & Infusions]

Data:Slnev.aladim.visiting.denzil.json.startdescription: Denzil and al-Adim resume their discussion on farriery. Al-Adim asks hypothetical questions about how one might shoe a hypothetical horse that could 'run upon the foam of the sea.' Denzil answers slowly, drawing from a folk-tale, in which such a horse is shod with the gold gathered from sun's reflection-path at its setting... [Lesson: Furs & Feathers]

Data:Slnev.aladim.visiting.killes.json.startdescription: Mrs Kille and al-Adim are exchanging proverbs. Him: 'Who cooks poison, eats it.' Her: 'The waves leave what the world's lost…' [Lesson: Rhyme & Remembrance]

Data:Slnev.aladim.visiting.timothy.json.startdescription: Al-Adim is recently back from New York. Reverend Timothy is instantly and ferociously curious about New York. It transpires that al-Adim did not particularly like New York.

Data:Slnev.aladim.yvette.json.startdescription: Yvette speaks of her monograph on 'Lagiah's Turn' - the ascension of the Queen Unsated to sit at the Red Grail's left hand - in which she develops a consistent Jungian interpretation of the myth. Al-Adim reacts with sceptical amusement - he claims to have met Lagiah - but Yvette is undaunted. 'Things don't have to be real to be true,' she points out. [Lesson: Hill & Hollow]

Data:Slnev.aladim.zachary.json.startdescription: Zachary and al-Adim speak of how things end; al-Adim with a kind of eager nostalgia; Zachary with simple eagerness. [Lesson: Putrefactions & Calcinations]

Data:Slnev.arthur.agdistis.json.startdescription: Agdistis invites Arthur to visit him in Berlin, but Arthur shakes his head. 'I can do without the temptation. The old ties would be too much for me. The War, I mean. We both know what's coming.' [Lesson: Auroral Contemplations]

Data:Slnev.arthur.aladim.json.startdescription: Arthur and al-Adim are discussing the dyes and dyers of the city of Tyre. [Lesson: Inks of Power]

Data:Slnev.arthur.arun.json.startdescription: Arthur and Arun are discussing which forbidden weapons should be permitted, and which weapons have been permitted too long. Arthur is concerned by rumours of Dawnbreaker experiments in Britain; Arun is bragging, a little, about his experiences with the terrible feather called the Imhullune Tectrix. [Lesson: Sharps]

Data:Slnev.arthur.azita.json.startdescription: Arthur has been describing the mirror-mazes of the Labyrinth of Lions to a smiling Azita - but now he seems to grow suspicious of her motives in questioning him, and he withdraws. [Lesson: Glaziery & Lightsmithing]

Data:Slnev.arthur.chaima.json.startdescription: Arthur and Chaima are talking guns. Chaima is disparaging about the reliability of the Berthier rifles once issued to her Goumier unit, but she and Arthur are both keenly interested in recent work of the Manufacture d'Armes de Saint-Étienne company… and both concerned about where to commission 'noble ammunition' for the new weapons. [Lesson: Disciplines of the Hammer]

Data:Slnev.arthur.connie.json.startdescription: Arthur and Connie are rather stiffly discussing the New King's projects. Both of them seem wary of each other. [Lesson: Disciplines of the Hammer]

Data:Slnev.arthur.coquille.json.startdescription: Coquille and Arthur are discussing the perils of family; the Crime of the Sky; the tragedy of Matthias and the Amethyst Imago. Coquille is at her most charming, and Arthur is at his most watchful. [Lesson: Desires & Dissolutions]

Data:Slnev.arthur.corso.json.startdescription: Arthur and Corso are discussing Ericapaean - a language that both of them are struggling to master. They agree to correspond in that language, although Corso points out that it'll probably get their post opened by the Suppression Bureau. [Lesson: Ericapaean]

Data:Slnev.arthur.dagmar.json.startdescription: Dagmar and Arthur toast past glories, and count the wars where their shifting nationalities have put them on opposing sides. [Lesson: Ragged Crossroads]
